explication: 3D Slicer is a desktop platform for medical-image visualization and analysis. A typical workflow brings data into a scene, operates on it through application modules, and visualizes or analyzes the result. The repository also exposes Python scripting, DICOM utilities, sample-data downloads, a REST API, and extension management. The tree and excerpts establish these major capabilities, but do not expose enough implementation detail to connect every subsystem. Edges below are limited to relationships stated in the README or shown by the source index.
